arguments.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) FROM payments f WHERE f.payment_status='failed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments o WHERE o.order_id=f.order_id AND o.payment_status='ok' AND o.paid_ts > f.paid_ts)) AS later_ok, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) FROM payments f WHERE f.payment_status='failed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments o WHERE o.order_id=f.order_id AND o.payment_status='ok')) AS any_ok, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM payments WHERE payment_status='failed') AS failed_any, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE paid_ts IS NULL) AS nullts
